optIn.title: New here? Want a short guided tour?
optIn.body: We can walk you through DeHub one step at a time, and ask how each step went so we can fix whatever is confusing.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.subtitle: A few short steps to set yourself up on DeHub.
checklist.finishedBody: Thank you for telling us how each step went. Your answers go straight to the people building this.

profile.title: Set your username and picture
profile.body: Pick a name people will recognise and add a profile picture, so your posts look like they came from you.

wallet.title: See your wallet and what DeHub tokens are
wallet.body: Your wallet already exists and holds your DeHub tokens. Take a look at what is in it and where it came from.

feed.title: Choose what you want to see
feed.body: Answer a couple of quick questions and your feed will start showing the kind of posts you actually want.

first-post.title: Make your first post
first-post.body: Share a thought, a photo or a video. It only takes a moment and it is how people find you.

follow.title: Follow three creators
follow.body: Your feed gets much better once you follow a few people. Browse who is here and pick three to start with.

comment.title: Leave a comment on a post
comment.body: Reply to something you liked on your feed. Conversations are where most of DeHub actually happens.

rewards.title: See how earning works
rewards.body: Find out how tips, badges and SuperPowers turn what you do here into something you earn from.
